name: Unbounded Coefficient-Space Component Counts at VC Dimension Four
statement: For a finite simple graph $H$, apply the union-closed construction after replacing each edge by opposite arcs. The coefficient-space components are indexed by acyclic orientations of $H$, and each is homeomorphic to $\mathbb R^{d_C}$. Taking $H=K_m$ gives exactly $m!$ components, so component counts are unbounded at VC dimension four.
proof: The minimal directed cycles are the opposite-arc two-cycles, so the arrangement is the graphical diagonal arrangement $d_v=d_w$. Each complement component orients every edge by increasing coordinate value; these are exactly the nonempty convex regions indexed by acyclic orientations.
